text:
Amy: Heads up 3 Acme OEM team wants quick answers before the exec call. They plan to ship a Redwood SDK inside their desktop installer for a co-sell POC. Main asks: can we license the SDK for OEM, what data crosses our network, telemetry defaults, and a POC price?
Marcus: I can take the SDK + license thread. Short answer: we have an OEM SDK license template but need legal signoff. We should avoid shipping any model weights. Will confirm whether offline-only (cache-first) mode is supported.
Nina: Security checklist: no persisted sensitive logs, TLS1.3, mTLS optional but preferred for private endpoints, API keys rotated via KMS, option to disable telemetry entirely, and we need to confirm DPA + SOC2 scope. Ask them for a sample dataflow diagram and IdP type (SAML/OIDC).
Raj: Pricing POV 3 for embedded clients we typically map to a Dedicated footprint plus a small per-miss request charge. For POC we can offer a timeboxed credit bucket. Will draft a couple scenarios (light, medium, heavy).
Amy: They also asked whether a client-side cache (local LevelDB) is allowed and if they can hash identifiers before sending.
Marcus: Architecture suggestion: SDK exposes a CacheProvider interface. Client does local cache for prefix hits. On miss, the SDK routes to a Private endpoint inside their VPC (we host a private connector). SDK must never write model files locally. Example minimal config: 
```json
{
  "endpoint": "https://redwood-private.acme.example",
  "auth_mode": "api_key",
  "cache": {"type":"leveldb","enabled":true,"ttl":43200},
  "telemetry": {"enabled":false}
}
```
Nina: About hashing: client-side hashing of emails will reduce semantic fidelity for embeddings. Recommend deterministic pseudonymization only if acceptable, or local token-removal + salt strategy and then run an A/B on quality. We'll want a small eval set (200-500 queries) from them to measure impact.
Raj: For the POC quote: propose a 1-month Dedicated node + 10M token credit + $0.20 per 1k cache-miss embedding calls beyond credits. Include an option: trial with burst-only (no reserved) at higher per-call price. Ill mark numbers provisional.
Amy: Next steps: Marcus 3 SDK draft + OEM license template to legal. Nina 3 security questionnaire + list of absolute blockers. Raj 3 provisional pricing scenarios and POC SOW. I'll schedule a 45m call with Acme for Fri 9am PT.
calendar-bot: Calendar event created: "Acme OEM co-sell POC kickoff" 3 Fri 9:00 AM PT. Invitation sent.
Marcus: Ill open a short repo branch with the CacheProvider stub and sample config before the call.
Nina: Sending the questionnaire DM now. Please review before we send externally.
Raj: Ill include telemetry opt-in language and support hours for the POC. :+1:
Amy: Thanks team. Also ask Acme to provide a sample anonymized dataset and their expected QPS for sizing.
